content:
maria: quick sync — decision needed: where should the new runtime-config controls live? API-only (developer-facing flags) vs Console (admin UI & audit) or both? I want to pick a sequence, not bikeshed forever.
aj: my instinct: ship lean API first, Console guardrails in M2. lower dev friction, faster measurable impact.
harper: +1 api-first for velocity, but we need a clear support story if customers call. Ramp plan?
zoe: agree on api-first but require: (1) per-customer toggle, (2) "audit log hooks". We can fake the admin UX with a simple CSV import at launch.
maria: ok can we do a quick RICE-ish compare in thread? we don't need perfect numbers, just prioritization signal.
aj: quick RICE sketches below (very rough):
```
Option A: API-only
Reach: medium (new devs + existing)
Impact: high (gets feature live, reduces infra ops)
Confidence: 60%
Effort: low
RICE score: ~ (Reach*Impact*Confidence)/Effort -> 6*8*0.6/2 ≈ 14

Option B: Console-first
Reach: low (admins only initially)
Impact: medium (safe UX but slower adoption)
Confidence: 70%
Effort: high
RICE score: ≈ 3

Option C: API + Console launch
Reach: high
Impact: high
Confidence: 40%
Effort: very high
RICE score: ≈ 8
```
harper: that matches my gut. API-only is the fastest path. but add launch criteria: telemetry shows 3 paying customers using api flags, no P0 support tickets in first 2 weeks, and perf impact < 5%.
zoe: can we define the "audit log hooks" as minimal: emit event to customer Kinesis/pubsub with schema {customer, config_key, old, new, actor}? then Console can subscribe later. Effort: small.
maria: yes that sounds fine. aj can you capture minimal API contract + sample events? put in /docs link: https://redwood.internal/specs/runtime-configs (placeholder)
aj: will do. also propose rollout policy: default off, opt-in per-customer, grace period for older SDKs.
harper: rollout: canary to 10% of traffic for first 48h, then 50% for a day, then 100%. monitor latency and error rates. rollback auto if tokenized latency delta > 10ms.
zoe: we should also plan Console "safety panel" as M2 milestone: admin toggle, history view, export CSV. estimate: 3 sprint-ish.
maria: decision check: API-minimal launch (M1) + Console safety panel (M2). guardrails: event webhook + per-customer toggle + canary rollout. anyone strongly disagree?
aj: :+1:
harper: :+1:
zoe: :+1: small ask: add enterprise feature flag in roadmap so AMs know timeline.
maria: noted — I'll create a concise spec and PR the roadmap item.
deploy-bot: created ticket TKT-4521 for "runtime-configs: API minimal + rollout plan" assigned to @aj
maria: thanks — next step: aj to draft API contract, harper to draft canary runbook, zoe to spec audit event schema. we'll reconvene Friday quick sync. :calendar: 
aj: ack.
harper: ack.
zoe: ack.
maria: quick poll reactions: :+1: if we go api-first, :-1: if prefer console-first
(reactions) :+1: x3, :-1: x1
maria: consensus looks clear. moving forward with api-first + console in M2.
